notes.title: [v0.3.2] System fonts and overall polishing of product.
notes.content:
[b][New Features][/b]
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40543374/8fee682fdd5391d6469babbd0744de6f35cdaa1c.png[/img]
[*] System fonts is now available
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40543374/c8ec8d82ed754abdddcf687b4c3a74ce217ec65d.png[/img]
[*] Number casting - now integer and float is castable, meaning that you can build a logic with less limitations.
[*] Multiply - takes two numbers as input returns a multiplied value.
[*] Bounce node - maps [0...1] value into [0...1...0], it is useful when you are trying to make recurring animations.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40543374/ed66f91c17879e014e3e95ceb3a253a8171fbcbb.png[/img]
[*] Blendquad - this is basically the same as Blendnode but blending shape is freeform quad.(like in overlayquad)
[/list]

[b][Improvements][/b]
[list]
[*] Give more control on noise nodes - Simplex noise now have 4 parameters including seed value. Perlin 3D have scale and height properties.
[*] Now overlay node is merged into blend node, and overlayquad node has changed to blendquad node, as one of it was subset of the other.
[*] `Center texture` feature now called `zoom to fit` as it is correct
[*] added `zoom to fit` button on RenderDialog
[/list]

[b][Bug fixes][/b]
[list]
[*] logic type check for operator nodes
[*] detect human node - update glitch fixed, it is working properly when you load a project with DHNode.
[/list]

notes.title: [v0.2.4] Project property view
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40543374/700b89efd214b11186a7d20679c9a7246d73607b.png[/img]

[b][New Features][/b]
[list]
[*]Now existing projects are easily configurable by simply focusing on the 'Output' node and its properties.
[*]You can access all input properties from the 'Output' node's property view.
[*]Now you can change the name of properties, it helps users better understand the project.
[/list]

[b][Improvements][/b]
[list]
[*]Recent items in 'Home tab' only show the history of local projects. built-in projects and subscribed items already have their places in the startup menu.
[*]Editor resizing now feels more natural.
[*]Added lock icon to projectItem, which indicates built-in projects and subscribed Items. I have blocked save behavior for this project, in order to prevent your progress on this work lost in the worst case. These items should be saved as another location, if you want to work on these templates.
[/list]

[b][Bug fixes][/b]
[list]
[*]Preview resizing glitch fixed.
[*]Project metadata(description, tags and so on) may be corrupted by another project.
[*]Many other UI glitches have been fixed.
[/list]
